$comment: Category hints only. Published resources, maturity, fields, interactions, and search parameters come from the environment's Medplum capability contract plus the official FHIR R4 package.

categories.Foundation: Cross-resource infrastructure — versioning, conformance, terminology binding, capabilities.
categories.Base: People, places and organisations participating in care.
categories.Clinical — Summary: Patient-summary content. The longitudinal clinical picture.
categories.Clinical — Request & Response: Orders, fulfilment and the workflow around them.
categories.Specialized — Public Health & Research: Adverse events, biospecimens, research subjects, evidence.
categories.Specialized — Devices: Device identity, definition, association and observation.
categories.Specialized — Quality & Testing: Measures, definitions, test scripts and reports.
categories.Specialized — Medication Definition: Regulatory & manufacturing models for medicinal products.
categories.Terminology: Code systems, value sets, mappings, naming.
categories.Conformance: Schemas, profiles, search params, capability statements.
